summary: Mini quadruped robot dog chassis and 2-part legs for 8x micro servos to walk and roll onto side/back for play-dead pose.
assumptions: uses 8x SG90 9g micro servos (23x12.5x22mm) for hips/shoulders + knees
battery 2x 18650 or 7.4V LiPo in central bay, control by ESP32/Arduino + servo driver (not printed)
play-dead = roll 90-120deg onto side, legs up, power-hold still

parts.name: Body Chassis Tub
parts.purpose: holds battery, controller, and 8 leg servos for walking and play-dead roll

parts.name: Upper Leg Hip Arm
parts.purpose: shoulder/hip lever from servo horn to knee servo for walk and legs-up play-dead pose

parts.name: Lower Leg with Foot
parts.purpose: knee to ground foot, tucks up during play-dead and supports standing/walking

print.orientation: chassis upside-down flat on bed, legs flat on side thickness up, foot disc down
